# Original SVG conformance artwork

These small geometric fixtures were authored for this repository. They contain no
third-party artwork or trademarks and follow the repository's MIT license.

They exercise winding, rounded radii, the four arc flag combinations, symbol
instances, unsupported strokes, gradients, transform composition and mirroring.
Two folders hold larger artwork for interoperability tests, outside the package:

- `animals/`: three layered, gradient-filled original illustrations (bear, owl, wolf) made for
  this project, under the repository's MIT license.
- `social/`: the X, GitHub and LinkedIn marks from
  [Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons), CC0-1.0. Their owners retain
  all trademark rights; see the README there.
